gray-alpha-50.$description: Neutral gray (#707070) at 50% opacity. Not a brand color: a neutral for rules and dividers.

brand.$description: The brand surface: the surface that follows the brand, such as the Arizona Header's fill. Blue by default; a theme can point it at another primary color, such as Red for the original red header. Repoint on-brand.* with it — aliases the brand palette.

default.$description: The default surface: the page background most content sits on, such as a breadcrumb's fill. Use on-default.* for what sits on it — aliases the brand palette.
Text and icons on surface.brand. Repoint it whenever a theme repoints surface.brand — aliases the brand palette.

border.$description: Borders and dividers on surface.brand, such as a form field's outline. Repoint it whenever a theme repoints surface.brand — aliases the brand palette.

placeholder.$description: Placeholder text in form fields on surface.brand. Repoint it whenever a theme repoints surface.brand — aliases the brand palette.

accent.$description: Accent for hover and focus on surface.brand, such as a form field's border while it has focus. Repoint it whenever a theme repoints surface.brand — aliases the brand palette.

focus-ring.$description: Keyboard focus ring on surface.brand. Repoint it whenever a theme repoints surface.brand — aliases the brand palette.

logo.$description: Logo color on surface.brand, such as the Arizona Header's wordmark. Separate from on-brand.default because a logo's color is its own brand decision: it can't follow every change to text color. Repoint it whenever a theme repoints surface.brand — aliases the brand palette.

pattern.$description: Decorative background patterns on surface.brand, such as Monsoon Rain. Repoint it whenever a theme repoints surface.brand — aliases the brand palette.

link.$description: Ordinary links on surface.default, such as a link in running text or an accordion's Copy link — aliases the brand palette.

link-hover.$description: Ordinary links on surface.default, on hover — aliases the brand palette.

link-supporting.$description: Supporting links and controls on surface.default, which back up ordinary links rather than compete with them, such as a breadcrumb's links and home icon or an accordion's titles — aliases the brand palette.

link-supporting-hover.$description: Supporting links and controls on surface.default on hover, or while open, such as an accordion's title — aliases the brand palette.

accent.$description: Accent on surface.default, such as the dividers between breadcrumb items — aliases the brand palette.

border.$description: Rules and dividers on surface.default, such as the line under each accordion title — aliases a neutral color.

focus-ring.$description: Keyboard focus ring on surface.default — aliases the brand palette.

pattern.$description: Decorative background patterns on surface.default, such as Monsoon Rain — aliases the brand palette.

highlight.$description: A light second accent on surface.default, such as the small star at the center of a focus point list marker — aliases the brand palette.

icon.$description: Decorative icons and markers on surface.default, such as a checklist's checkmarks — aliases the brand palette.

scroll-offset.$description: How far below the top of the screen a linked section stops when the page scrolls to it, such as an accordion item opened from a link. A fixed header raises it so the header doesn't cover the section.

serif.$description: Serif: Garamond Premier Pro, falling back to Georgia and Times New Roman.

sans.$description: Sans serif: Proxima Nova, falling back to system sans-serif fonts, then emoji fonts.

20.$description: 20%, a share of the size of what contains it.

0-667.$description: 0.667 times something's own size, such as a heading's font size.

1-042.$description: 1.042 times something's own size, such as a heading's font size.

ease-in-out.$description: CSS ease-in-out: starts and ends slowly.

typography.$description: Text styles for running copy and headings, across the page. Text colors aren't part of these styles.

size.$description: Body copy text size.
Lead copy text size: an introductory paragraph a step larger than body copy.

line-height.$description: Lead copy, an introductory paragraph a step larger than body copy: line height.

size.$description: Small copy text size.

family.$description: Heading typeface: the same sans serif as body copy, unless a page opts into serif headings (heading.serif).

letter-spacing.$description: Every heading level's letter spacing: none.

margin-top.$description: Space above a heading (h2–h6), as a multiple of its own text size (1.042em). h1 replaces it.

margin-bottom.$description: Space below every heading, as a multiple of its own text size (0.667em).

size.$description: h1 text size, below the lg breakpoint (992px).

margin-top.$description: Space above h1, as a multiple of its text size (0.667em): the same as below it, so h1's spacing is even.

size.$description: h2 text size, below the lg breakpoint (992px).
h3 text size, below the lg breakpoint (992px).
h4 text size, at every screen size.

line-height.$description: h4 line height, at every screen size.

size.$description: h5 text size, at every screen size.

line-height.$description: h5 line height, at every screen size.

size.$description: h6 text size, at every screen size.

line-height.$description: h6 line height, at every screen size.

size.$description: h1 text size from the lg breakpoint (992px) up.
h2 text size from the lg breakpoint (992px) up.
h3 text size from the lg breakpoint (992px) up.

family.$description: Heading typeface for pages that opt into serif headings: every level with the serif style, or only h1–h3 with the mixed style (h4–h6 stay sans serif).

height.$description: Header height: its minimum height at every screen size, and its fixed height below 992px.

color.$description: Header fill: the brand surface, Blue by default. The original red header comes from a theme that points surface.brand at Red.
Color of the header's wordmark logo.

width.$description: Wordmark width below the sm breakpoint (576px).

height.$description: Wordmark height below the sm breakpoint (576px).

width.$description: Wordmark width from the sm breakpoint (576px) up.

height.$description: Wordmark height from the sm breakpoint (576px) up.

margin-left.$description: Space before the wordmark, at the header's left edge.

color.$description: Keyboard focus ring on the logo and header buttons, drawn inside the element's edge.

width.$description: Width of the inset keyboard focus ring on the logo and header buttons.

radius.$description: Corner radius of the logo and header buttons while they have keyboard focus, so the ring has rounded corners.

color.$description: Header button text and icon color.

size.$description: Header button label text size ("Search", "Menu").
Header button icon width and height: the icon is 24px square, whether it's an SVG, a sprite or a font glyph.

color.$description: Header button icon color: the same as the label, so icons and text change together. An SVG icon picks it up through fill="currentColor".

gap.$description: Space between a header button's icon and its label.

y.$description: Header button top and bottom padding.

min-height.$description: Header button minimum height: the header's own height.

duration.$description: How long a header button's colors and focus ring take to change. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

easing.$description: Easing for a header button's color and focus ring changes. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

scroll-offset.$description: When the header is fixed on mobile (below 992px): the page's scroll offset, how far below the top of the screen linked sections stop when scrolled to, so the header doesn't cover them.

duration.$description: How long the off-canvas panel (opened by the header buttons) takes to slide in or out. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

easing.$description: Easing for the off-canvas panel's slide. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

duration.$description: How long the backdrop behind the off-canvas panel takes to fade in or out. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

easing.$description: Easing for the off-canvas backdrop's fade. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

height.$description: Height of a text field with an attached button.

x.$description: Space between the field's left and right edges and its text.

y.$description: Space above and below the field's text.

size.$description: Field text size.

padding.$description: Space around the attached button's icon.

size.$description: The attached button's icon width and height.

width.$description: Border width around the field and button together.

radius.$description: Corner radius of the field and button together.

width.$description: Width of the line between the field and the button: the same as the border.

duration.$description: How long the divider's color takes to change when the field gains or loses focus. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

easing.$description: Easing for the divider's color change. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

color.$description: Field text color on the brand surface.
Placeholder text color on the brand surface.
Border color on the brand surface, around the field and button.
Color of the line between the field and button on the brand surface.
The attached button's icon color on the brand surface.
The attached button's icon color on hover, on the brand surface.
Border color while the field or button has focus, on the brand surface.
Divider color while the field or button has focus, on the brand surface.

max-width.$description: Search form's maximum width. It's an input group, so its other values come from az.component.input-group.

x.$description: Space to the left and right of the search form.

y.$description: Space above and below the search form.

color.$description: Keyboard focus ring on the button that shows the search form on small screens, on the brand surface.

width.$description: Width of that button's keyboard focus ring.

color.$description: Breadcrumb's fill.

x.$description: Space to the left and right of the breadcrumb (0.609rem).

y.$description: Space above and below the breadcrumb.

margin-bottom.$description: Space below the breadcrumb, below the lg breakpoint (992px).
Space below the breadcrumb from the lg breakpoint (992px) up: none.

size.$description: Size of every item's text, linked or current.

weight.$description: Weight of every item's text, linked or current.

line-height.$description: Line height of every item's text: the same as its size.

color.$description: Linked items' text.
The current page's item, which isn't a link.
Linked items' text on hover: unchanged, so the underline shows the hover.
Underline under a linked item on hover: the same color as its text.

offset.$description: How far below the text's baseline the hover underline sits, on every item, Home included.

color.$description: The / between items.

gap.$description: Space on each side of the / between items.

color.$description: The house icon before Home: the link color, and part of the link.

size.$description: Width and height of the house icon before Home (1.2rem).

gap.$description: Space between the house icon and Home.

raise.$description: How far the house icon sits above the text's top edge, so it lines up with the text the way it does on arizona.edu.

color.$description: Title text, collapsed.

family.$description: Title typeface: serif by default. typeface.sans replaces it.

size.$description: Title text size (large, the default size), below the md breakpoint (768px).

x.$description: Space to the left and right of the title: none, so titles line up with the text around them.

y.$description: Space above and below the title.

gap.$description: Space between the title text and its icon (large), below 768px.

color.$description: The line under each title.

width.$description: Thickness of the line under each title.

color.$description: The plus/minus icon: the title's color.

size.$description: Diameter of the circled icon (large), below 768px.

length.$description: Length of the icon's plus/minus lines (large), below 768px.

radius.$description: Rounded ends of the icon's lines.

width.$description: Thickness of the icon's circle and lines, collapsed.

x.$description: Space to the left and right of the body: none.

y.$description: Space above and below the body, below 768px.

size.$description: Title text size (large) from the md breakpoint (768px) up.

gap.$description: Space between the title text and its icon (large) from 768px up.

size.$description: Diameter of the circled icon (large) from 768px up.

length.$description: Length of the icon's lines (large) from 768px up.

y.$description: Space above and below the body from 768px up.

color.$description: Title text on hover.

width.$description: Thickness of the icon's circle and lines on hover.

color.$description: Title text while the item is open: the same as on hover.

width.$description: Thickness of the icon's circle and lines while open: the same as on hover.

color.$description: Keyboard focus ring around a title.

width.$description: Width of the keyboard focus ring.

offset.$description: Space between a title and its keyboard focus ring.

size.$description: Title text size, medium size.

letter-spacing.$description: Title letter spacing, medium size: none.

gap.$description: Space between the title text and its icon, medium size.

size.$description: Diameter of the circled icon, medium size.

length.$description: Length of the icon's lines, medium size.

size.$description: Title text size, small size.

letter-spacing.$description: Title letter spacing, small size: none.

gap.$description: Space between the title text and its icon, small size.

size.$description: Diameter of the circled icon, small size.

length.$description: Length of the icon's lines, small size.

family.$description: Title typeface for the sans serif style.

color.$description: The Copy link at the bottom of an item's body: icon and label.
The Copy link on hover.

size.$description: Size of the Copy link's icon (a link icon, then a check after copying).

gap.$description: Space between the Copy link's icon and its label.

margin-top.$description: Space above the Copy link, at the bottom of the body.

offset.$description: How far below the label the Copy link's underline sits (0.25em at the 18px body size). Only the label is underlined, not the icon.

color.$description: Every pattern's color on a default (White) section. Pattern images are masks, so this paints them.
Every pattern's color on a brand (Blue) section.

width.$description: Width of Monsoon Rain's band along a section's start or end edge, as a share of the section's width.

min-width.$description: Narrowest the band gets, on narrow screens.

max-width.$description: Widest the band gets, on wide screens, so the pattern stays a small accent.

size.$description: Size of Monsoon Rain's image (assets/patterns/monsoon-rain.svg, a mask in the pattern's color). It repeats down the band from the top.
Size of a focus point or checkmark marker. It's centered on the item's first line.

gap.$description: Space between a marker and its item's text.
Space between list items. The last item keeps the list's usual space below it.
Space between items in a nested list, and above the nested list.

color.$description: The focus point marker's disc, with a four-pointed star cut into it. The same on every surface.
The small star at the center of the focus point marker. The same on every surface.
The checkmark marker on a default (White) section.
The checkmark marker on a brand (Blue) section, where the default is too dark to read.
